content.short: Advix.com provides tech, CySec, Web3, and Compliance Advisory by ex-C-suite from top fintech, crypto, and banking firms.
content.description: Advix delivers strategic guidance for blockchain projects, paired with strong cybersecurity services and virtual C-level executive support (CTO, CISO, CIO, CPO, CFO). The firm helps clients meet industry compliance standards, safeguard IT infrastructure and data from cyber threats through audits and penetration testing, and tailor Web3 and digital asset strategies. It also develops robust tokenomics and governance models to support secure, scalable growth and informed decision making.
